install.title: How to install your eSIM
install.subtitle: Follow the steps for your phone. The whole process takes about two minutes.
install.android_menu: Settings → Network & internet → SIMs → Add eSIM

iphone.s1_d: Open the order email with your QR code on another device, or save a screenshot of the QR code. The iPhone camera cannot scan a QR code shown on its own screen.
iphone.s1_shot: Screenshot: AirQr order email with QR code
iphone.s2_d: Open Settings → Cellular → Add eSIM. If you travel with more than one line, pick the line you want to add the eSIM to first.
iphone.s3_d: Point the camera at the QR code. If scanning fails, make sure the whole code fits on screen and increase brightness.
iphone.s3_shot: Screenshot: Scanning the eSIM QR code
iphone.s4_d: iOS will verify and install the eSIM profile. Keep the phone connected to Wi-Fi during this step.
iphone.s5_t: Label the lines for calls and data
iphone.s5_d: Choose "Primary" for the line you use for calls and "Cellular" for the eSIM. Keeping them separate makes it easy to switch which line handles data.
iphone.s5_shot: Screenshot: Choosing Primary / Cellular line labels
iphone.s6_t: Enable data roaming before you land
iphone.s6_d: Once you arrive, open Settings → Cellular → your eSIM line and turn on Data Roaming so the plan activates abroad.
iphone.s6_shot: Screenshot: eSIM line with Data Roaming on
iphone.t1: You can install the eSIM before departure and switch it on only when you land.
iphone.t2: Do not delete the eSIM profile if you still need the QR code — you will need it to reinstall.

android.s1_d: Go to Settings → Network & internet → SIMs and tap "Add eSIM". The exact wording varies slightly by manufacturer.
android.s2_d: Some models show a QR scanner automatically; others ask you to scan a QR code from another screen. Open the AirQr email on a second device if needed.
android.s3_d: Review the plan details and confirm. Android may ask for a verification code sent to your email.
android.s4_t: Set the eSIM as the data line
android.s4_d: In SIM settings, open the eSIM and enable Mobile data so it is used for internet access.
android.s5_d: Turn on Roaming for the eSIM line after you land, so the plan can connect to the local network.
android.t1: If the QR scanner cannot read the code, save it as an image and open it from the gallery instead.
android.t2: Some Android versions hide eSIM options under "Reset" if no SIM tray is detected.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Answers about buying, installing and using your eSIM.
faq.not_found_body: Write to us — we reply within 24 hours.

purchase.how_to_buy: How do I buy an eSIM on AirQr?
purchase.how_to_buy_a: Choose your destination, pick a plan by data volume and validity, enter your email and pay. The QR code and activation details appear on the order page right after payment.
purchase.payment_methods: Which payment methods do you accept?
purchase.payment_methods_a: Payments are simulated in this demo: no real charge is made and no card is required. The production version accepts bank cards along with Apple Pay / Google Pay.
purchase.gift: Can I buy an eSIM as a gift?
purchase.gift_a: Yes. Buy the plan using the recipient's email — the email with the QR code goes to that address. Add their name in the name field.
purchase.group_discounts_a: For orders of five or more, contact support and we will prepare individual terms and a link for each participant.
purchase.promo_code: How do I apply a promo code?
purchase.promo_code_a: Enter the promo code on the checkout page before pressing the pay button. Active codes are listed in our emails and promotions.

installation.iphone: How do I install an eSIM on iPhone?
installation.iphone_a: Open the email with the QR code on another device, then go to Settings → Cellular → Add eSIM and point your camera at the code.
installation.android: How do I install an eSIM on Android?
installation.android_a: Open Settings → Network & internet → SIMs → Add eSIM and scan the QR code with your camera.
installation.how_long_a: Usually 2–5 minutes on a stable connection. If the code does not scan the first time, increase your screen brightness.
installation.qr_fails: What if the QR code does not scan?
installation.qr_fails_a: Save the QR code as an image and open it from your gallery, or enter the activation string manually — it is shown on the order page.
installation.tablet: Can I install an eSIM on a tablet?
installation.tablet_a: Yes, if the model supports eSIM: iPad Pro and Air from 2020, iPad mini from 2021, and a number of Samsung tablets with eSIM support.

usage.activation_a: Data is counted from your first connection to a local network, not from the purchase date. Validity is counted in days from activation.
usage.data_roaming_a: It is using the local network while abroad. For an AirQr eSIM you need to turn on Data Roaming for the line after you land.
usage.physical_sim: Do I need to remove the physical SIM?
usage.physical_sim_a: No. You can keep both active: the physical SIM for calls and SMS, the eSIM for internet. This is the best way not to miss bank verification codes.
usage.whatsapp: Does WhatsApp work on an eSIM?
usage.whatsapp_a: WhatsApp runs over the internet, so it works through the eSIM. Note that VoIP services are blocked in the UAE and some other countries.
usage.no_internet: What if the internet does not work?
usage.no_internet_a: Check that mobile data and roaming are enabled for the eSIM line and that airplane mode is off. If that does not help, contact support.

refund.can_refund: Can I get a refund for an eSIM?
refund.can_refund_a: If the eSIM does not work, we refund in full. Contact support with your order email and a description of the problem.
refund.not_working: What if my eSIM does not work?
refund.not_working_a: First restart your phone and make sure the eSIM line is active. If there is still no connection, write to us and we will replace the profile.
refund.contact_a: Use the form on the Contact page, the chat helper in the corner of the screen, or message us directly on Telegram.
refund.warranty_a: Yes, a refund guarantee applies: if the eSIM does not work we refund your payment or send a new profile.

chat.a_start: Data starts counting from the first time you connect to a local network, not from the purchase date.
chat.q_physical: Do I need to remove my physical SIM?
chat.a_physical: No. Keep both active — physical SIM for calls and SMS, eSIM for internet.
chat.a_refund: Yes. If the eSIM does not work we refund in full — contact support with your order email.
